title: matricaria chamomilla f. suaveolens
intro: Matricaria chamomilla f. suaveolens, commonly known as Pineapple Chamomile, is a variant of the popular medicinal herb Matricaria chamomilla, which is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is widely recognized for its calming and soothing effects, offering several health benefits such as reducing anxiety and inflammation, promoting relaxation, and alleviating symptoms of insomnia and restlessness. The therapeutic actions of Pineapple Chamomile include acting as a sedative, anti-anxiety agent, and anti-inflammatory, which can help to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties, including apigenin, luteolin, and pinocamphone, which contribute to its sedative and anti-inflammatory effects.
